title: Master Chief's last words at the end of Halo 3

Should Master Chief have stayed asleep? 👇

tags: wake me when you need me

scenes.text: "Wake me, when you need me." That was how Master Chief said goodbye in Halo 3.
Fleeing Installation 08, the Forward Unto Dawn was cut in two by a collapsing portal.
The Arbiter reached Earth in the front half. John and Cortana drifted away in the back.
On Earth, Lord Hood held a memorial for the fallen, Chief among them.
Cortana stayed awake to drop a beacon as he went into cryo sleep.
He slept for four years, seven months and ten days.
Then the wreck drifted toward a Forerunner world called Requiem, and Cortana woke him.
